title: Compound-wing (VTOL) model
current_gap: Compound-wing model source, control stack/actuators and flight conditions (including transition) are missing; ArduCopter must not be forced into this role without a compound-wing configuration.

atoms.name: model_source
atoms.required: Pinned compound-wing model source with aerodynamic and propulsion parameters

atoms.name: lift_rotor_actuation
atoms.required: Both actuator sets (lifting rotors and wing surfaces) mapped with units and limits

atoms.name: transition_conditions
atoms.required: Hover/transition/cruise conditions with expected responses and identity

atoms.name: no_forced_arducopter
atoms.required: Rule enforced: a plain multicopter stack is never wired as a compound-wing controller

scope_rule: compound-wing coverage requires both actuator sets and the transition regime; neither multicopter nor fixed-wing evidence alone covers it
